title: REVERSE DELAY -- granular delay that plays its echoes backwards (stereo in)

sections.heading: USING IT (CORE)
lines: Click the speaker (ezdac~) to start audio. The output is 100% wet -- mix dry elsewhere.
Preset: slots 1-6 are factory sounds; slot 1 Reverse Bloom loads on open. Faders are not stored.
Time: delay before each grain plays (50-4000 ms). Grain: length of each reversed grain.
For an obvious reversal use Grain 500-2000 ms; short grains give a backwards smear.
Density: how many grains overlap. Feedback: how much output returns into the delay.
Low Cut / High Cut: filters in the feedback path only -- each repeat gets thinner or darker.
Width: random left/right spread per grain.
Sync on: Time follows the global transport BPM and Division. Run and BPM drive that transport.

sections.heading: ADVANCED
lines: Jitter, Scatter ms, Size Rand, Gain Rand: randomise spawn timing, delay, length and level.
Shape: grain window (Hann, Tukey, Gaussian, Triangular, Expo-Decay). Tilt, Tukey a reshape it.
Grain Count: max simultaneous grains. Direction: chance a grain plays forward instead.
Regen dB, Diffusion, Drive: gain, allpass smear and tanh grit inside the feedback loop.
Duck: pushes the wet signal down while you play. Drift Rate / Depth: slow wobble of Time.
Source: Mono Sum reads L+R; Stereo lets each grain read one input channel.

sections.heading: INPUTS & OUTPUTS
lines: Stereo input (adc~ 1 2), stereo output. The in and out fader pairs are linked.
In and out gain~ faders with meters; both reset to unity on load.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: One gen~ codebox writes the input into a 14-second ring buffer.
A scheduler spawns up to 32 windowed grains that read the ring backwards.
Feedback goes back into the same ring, so each repeat flips direction again.
All per-grain values are fixed when the grain starts, so knob moves stay click-free.
